name: Night Shift
hook: Guard the toy shop until 6 AM. Shut the doors.
how: The wind-up toys walk at night. Split the guard stations: one watches the cameras, two hold the doors and one keeps the music box playing. Doors and lights eat power, so shut them only when something is there.
controls: 1–4 picks a station, Space shuts the door, winds or flips the camera, hold L for the door light, or tap the buttons
uses: The host's browser moves the toys, drains the power and runs the clock; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots run every station nobody has taken, so you can play alone.
Every door, light and camera switch shows for the whole team at once.
